name: appearTimer
meaning: Set to 0x3c00 (3.75 s of g_gameTime) by SetState(3); no reader found in the class.

name: inInventory
meaning: 1 after msg 7 (stored in the inventory), 0 after msg 8 (equipped); makes msg 0x4a80 report the coin as taken.

name: claimedBySam
meaning: Set by msg 0x4a83 (Sam pocketing it); msg 2 then offers nothing to the Wolf. Cleared by SetState 0 and 2.

name: revealed
meaning: Set to 1 when the MineDetector's msg 0x2f reveals a buried coin; cleared only by Init. Reset picks buried (0) or visible-at-home (1) from it.

name: homePos
meaning: Ground-snapped start position (Init); SetState(0) and Reset move the coin here.

name: renderScale
meaning: Uniform render scale, 0 meaning 0x400; set by Sam msg 0x4a82 while pocketing (0x2aa, 0x155), cleared by SetState(0) and Reset.

name: hintPending
meaning: 1 after msg 0x4a84 (Sam near the Wolf while it holds this coin); consumed by the next msg 6.

name: hintDist
meaning: Sam-Wolf XZ distance from msg 0x4a84, or the outDist that Scenaric_FindBestInRadius writes (600 when nothing is found); msg 6 reports hintDist*0xffff/600.
